# AgentGuard

> Python runtime guards for instrumented AI agents. Repository: agent47.
> Install agentguard47; import agentguard. The base SDK has no runtime dependencies.

## Read first

- [README](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/README.md): Installation, runnable example, enforcement limits.
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/docs/README.md): Guides and references by task.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/docs/guides/getting-started.md): Local trace and provider setup.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup and checks.
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository contribution rules.

## Source references

- [Package metadata](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/sdk/pyproject.toml): Branch version, Python floor, optional dependencies.
- [Public API](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/sdk/agentguard/__init__.py): Supported imports.
- [Guards](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/sdk/agentguard/guards.py): Budget, loop, timeout, retry, and rate checks.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/bmdhodl/agent47/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Versioned changes.
- [Published package](https://pypi.org/project/agentguard47/): Published metadata.

## Boundaries

Checks apply only where integrated. Budget preflight checks recorded usage;
it does not reserve concurrent capacity or predict the next response's cost.
Streaming totals are not yet tracked by provider patches. Guards are not a
sandbox. Local traces need no hosted account. Remote sinks are optional.
